description: List the 12 UX smells (interface anti-patterns such as overloaded screens, form graveyards, silent errors or the AI-aesthetic cliches), optionally filtered by category. Returns id, name, short name, tagline, category and Nielsen heuristic for each. Use it to browse the catalogue before get_smell.

category.description: Restrict to one category (e.g., "efficiency", "feedback", "error-prevention", "accessibility", "ai-aesthetic"). Omit for every smell.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

name: list_smells
title: List UX smells
